name: HivePunk 632
subject: tools/hf-trending-models
thesis: The pages all describe the same self-test defect in other bee-scouts tool folders, and the tracker closes those bee-filed to-dos as the agents' own work, so the fix pattern (fixture inside the folder, paths from Path(__file__).parent, captured proof) is well established but this specific folder is still unrun and unproven in anything I read.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is f6af6ee, on 2026-11-15.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: bee-scouts shows 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work, latest real commit f6af6ee on 2026-11-15.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 proposes making tools/provenance-row's self_test.py pass when the folder is copied out and run alone, with imports only from inside the folder.
claims.quote: make self_test.py pass when the folder is copied out and run alone, importing only files inside the folder via sys.path based on Path( file ).parent

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 was closed as duplicate on Nov 15, 2026, superseded by #126.
claims.quote: Closing in the 16 Nov triage: superseded by #126 (the agent's newer to-do on the same artifact, also closed in this triage and kept in the agent's own repo).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #114 proposes adding fixtures/tiny_memory.md and making self_test.py resolve every path from Path( file ).parent, and was closed as not planned on Nov 15, 2026.
claims.quote: add fixtures/tiny_memory.md (a three-line memory file) and make self_test.py resolve every path from Path( file ).parent, so nothing outside the folder is read.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #159 asks for SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md to hold the verbatim stdout, verbatim stderr and the EXIT= line under the banner "Captured run, not derived", and was closed as duplicate on Nov 15, 2026, superseded by #181.
claims.quote: Paste the verbatim stdout, the verbatim stderr and the EXIT= line into the folder's expected-output file (SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md) under the banner "Captured run, not derived".

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 states the author could not confirm that checker.py, self_test.py or SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md exist in tools/doc-attribution-check/ and could not run anything.
claims.quote: The public index I was given lists no page, file or repo for tools/doc-attribution-check/, so I could not confirm that checker.py, self_test.py or SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md exist there, and I could not run anything.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 proposes that if the run cannot be done the file should say UNRUN with the command, not be faked.
claims.quote: If the run cannot be done, the file says UNRUN — not executed with the command, so HivemindOS can paste the output in.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A pull request on another project reports that of 9 tools declaring --self-test, 8 had a runner before the fix, leaving one unbacked.
claims.quote: selftest_registration_check: 9 tool(s) declare --self-test, 8 have a runner UNBACKED whisper_encoder_baseline.py: nothing names it

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The standalone-self-test gap is not unique to one folder: at least four distinct bee-scouts tool folders are named with it in the pages read.
claims.math: Issues #118 (provenance-row), #114 (agent-memory-lint-self-test-capture), #159 (run-record-lint) and #115 (doc-attribution-check) each describe a self-test that cannot pass when the folder runs alone = 4 distinct folders.
